hop_glosses: Hop 1 identifies the reaction as nuclei combining into a larger nucleus; hop 2 supplies how its mass difference manifests.

sufficient_sets.text: Nuclear fusion is a reaction in which two or more atomic nuclei combine to form a larger nucleus.
The difference in mass between the reactants and products is manifested as either the release or the absorption of energy.

labels.answer_text: either the release or the absorption of energy
